bricks.headline: Austin Championship Delayed by Rain
bricks.summary: Heavy rain forced the Austin Championship to finish on Monday. Trace Crowe leads the tournament by one shot. Many other players remain close behind in the standings.
bricks.whyItMatters: Golf fans will have to wait an extra day to see which golfer wins the event and takes home the prize money.
bricks.explainer: The Austin Championship is a golf tournament that was interrupted by bad weather. In golf, when heavy rain makes the course unplayable, officials must stop the game to keep players safe and maintain the condition of the grass. Because the tournament could not finish on Sunday, it was moved to Monday. Trace Crowe is currently in first place, but since 13 other players are within three shots of his score, the outcome of the tournament is still undecided. Players must now return to the course to finish their final rounds to determine the winner.

bricks.headline: Former Delivery Driver Earns PGA Tour Card
bricks.summary: Joe Dean earned his official PGA Tour card on Sunday. He previously worked as a grocery delivery driver to pay for his golf training.
bricks.whyItMatters: This story highlights a path for professional athletes who do not have major sponsors early in their careers.
bricks.explainer: A PGA Tour card is a highly valued status that allows a golfer to play in the top professional golf events. Many players struggle for years to earn this spot because they have to pay for their own travel and training costs. Joe Dean, a golfer from England, worked as a grocery delivery driver to afford the costs of competing while trying to reach the professional level. By earning his tour card, he now gains access to compete in major tournaments against the best players in the world.
